lines: •Xcel Energy narrows its 2026 ongoing earnings per share guidance to $4.10 to $4.16.
•Xcel Energy initiates its 2027 ongoing earnings per share guidance of $4.48 to $4.62.
The filing is based on a 2026 forecast test year and includes an ROE of 10.65%, a 52.5% equity ratio and rate base of $1.5 billion.

Xcel Energy 2026 Earnings Guidance — Xcel Energy’s 2026 ongoing earnings guidance is a narrowed range of $4.10 to $4.16 per share, from the original guidance of $4.04 to $4.16 per share.
Xcel Energy 2027 Earnings Guidance — Xcel Energy’s 2027 ongoing earnings guidance is a range of $4.48 to $4.62 per share.
